title: How much of the chikki is still left?
description: Ziva and the younger brother have eaten three fourths of the chikki. The whole is written as four fourths, and the eaten part is taken away. Keeko doubts the answer by comparing the piece left with the eaten pieces.
teaching_notes: One idea: to find what is left, write the whole in the same fractional unit as the eaten part and take away. Watch for students who compare the left piece with the eaten pieces instead of the whole.

source: Ziva ate 1/2 of the chikki and her brother ate 1/4 of it, s
video_script.why: A learner finds the part that is left by writing the whole as four fourths and taking away the three fourths eaten.
video_script.substitution: the book's own chikki, with three fourths eaten
video_script.anchor: the chikki strip cut into four equal pieces, with three pieces eaten
video_script.wrong_answer: one third of the chikki is left
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko compares the one piece left with the three pieces eaten and says one third is left, instead of comparing it with the whole of four pieces.
video_script.payoff_line: one fourth of the chikki is left

final_answer.spoken: one fourth of the chikki is left

video_script.fraction_reading: one half, one fourth, three fourths, four fourths, one third

names.Ziva: eats one half of the chikki her father made

never_show: one third as the part left before Keeko's doubt
maths_rules: slip: Keeko compares the 1 piece left with the 3 pieces eaten and says 1/3; the whole has 4 pieces, so the part left is 1/4
video_script.design: The chikki strip from the last video stays on the board, with three of four pieces eaten. The whole is written as four fourths, and the eaten part is taken away.

beats.on_screen: a small title card From your book; a chikki strip of 4 equal pieces with 3 pieces shaded as eaten; the words how much is left? appear

marks.book: the small title card From your book appears and the chikki strip appears
marks.eaten: three of the four pieces are shaded as eaten
marks.ask: the words how much is left? appear

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is from your book, where Ziva and the younger brother have eaten some chikki.
<bookmark mark='eaten'/>Together they have eaten three fourths of the whole chikki.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>How much of the chikki is still left?

beats.on_screen: the chikki strip holds still and the question stays on the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

beats.on_screen: three strips of equal length: 2/2, 3/3 and 4/4, each fully shaded and labelled 1 whole

marks.whole: three equal strips cut into two, three and four parts are fully shaded and each is labelled one whole
marks.take: the words whole minus eaten appear under the strips

narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>One whole can be written in any fractional unit. It is two halves, or three thirds, or four fourths.
<bookmark mark='take'/>To find what is left, we take away the part eaten from the whole.

beats.on_screen: Given: the part eaten is 3/4 of the chikki
narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the part of the chikki that is eaten is three fourths.

beats.on_screen: To find: the part of the chikki that is left
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find how much of the whole chikki is left.

marks.whole: 1 = 4/4 is written and the four pieces of the strip are counted

narration: <bookmark mark='whole'/>Step one, the whole chikki is one, and in fourths that is four fourths.

marks.take: 4/4 - 3/4 is written and three pieces are lifted off the strip

narration: <bookmark mark='take'/>Step two, they ate three fourths, so we take three fourths away from four fourths.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: both are in fourths, so take away the numbers of fourths: 4 - 3 = 1 piece of size 1/4

marks.left: the one piece left on the strip glows

narration: <bookmark mark='count'/>Step three, both are in fourths, so we take away the numbers of fourths. Four take away three leaves one.
<bookmark mark='left'/>That is one piece, and each piece is one fourth of the chikki.

beats.on_screen: Answer: 1/4 of the chikki is left

marks.ans: 1/4 of the chikki is left is written and glows

narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>One piece of one fourth remains, so one fourth of the chikki is left.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the chikki strip
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: a bubble says 1 piece left and 3 pieces eaten, so 1/3; the strip shows all 4 pieces counted; the bubble is struck out

marks.doubt: the bubble with the wrong idea appears
marks.whole: the strip shows all four equal pieces and they are counted one by one

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks one third of the chikki is left, because one piece is left and three are eaten.
<bookmark mark='whole'/>But the whole chikki was cut into four equal pieces, not into three equal pieces.
<bookmark mark='fix'/>We compare the piece left with the whole chikki, never with the eaten pieces.
